opening.argument: The video promotes a reward scheme in which viewers are told they can earn free Paytm cash by watching SidTalk videos, while coupon codes appear randomly and only briefly. The instructions then move viewers to a Coupon Zone website to enter and submit those codes, followed by mobile-number verification through an OTP. The final step requests a Paytm number and UPI code for payment details, tying the requested information directly to receiving money. Access is also framed as scarce: each coupon is limited to one person, and an unfinished process becomes available to others after 10 minutes. Taken together, the video combines a low-barrier promise of cash with rapid, competitive redemption and the collection of payment-related details.
